name: quarterly-report-utils
description: Utilities for quarterly studio report generation — JQL construction, studio config lookup, and Confluence XHTML formatting

tools.name: resolve_studio
tools.description: Look up a studio's full configuration by name from the vertical config. Returns query method, project, board IDs, sprint prefix, sub-task setting, and all metadata needed for Jira queries.

tools.name: build_jql
tools.description: Construct the correct JQL query for a studio's resolved issues in a given quarter. Handles studio_field, sprint_based, and combined query methods. Applies sub-task exclusions and assignee exclusions automatically.

studio_name.description: Studio name (looked up from vertical config)

tools.name: format_confluence_page
tools.description: Convert structured report data into Confluence Cloud storage format (XHTML). Generates tables, status lozenges, info panels, and page structure matching the OUTPUT_TEMPLATE.

metrics.description: Metrics table data: {resolved, created, net_backlog, issue_mix, velocity}

methodology.description: Data source info: {project, filter_method, filter_value, date_filter, sub_tasks, board, sprint_range, jql}

business_impact.description: Business impact narrative (2-3 paragraphs, HTML allowed)

roadmap.description: Array of roadmap rows: [{lane, milestone, timeline, status, status_color}]

director_metrics.description: Director metrics: {impact_classification, guest_reach, release_success_rate, health_rating, velocity, blocked_items}
